name: Ismael
summary: Ismael is a local Facebook Marketplace buyer who contacted the phone owner about purchasing a PlayStation controller listed for sale. He asked for photos, confirmed the controller was practically new, and drove roughly 20 minutes to complete an in-person pickup the same day. He asked about Zelle and mentioned he only had $60 cash on hand; conversation ends with him 5 minutes away. No business services were discussed — this is a personal marketplace sale.
key_facts: Found the listing on Facebook (Marketplace) for a PlayStation controller
Lives about 20 minutes away from the phone owner
Asked if Zelle was accepted; owner said yes
Said he only had $60 cash on him at the time
Owner sold it because he only plays Xbox; also mentioned owning an unused PlayStation
Meetup was in progress at the end of the thread — outcome of sale not confirmed
